summary: Connected account, payment, progress, inactivity, completion, membership, billing, and support triggers to a first-party lifecycle dispatcher. Existing transactional senders are ledgered without double-send. New progress, inactivity, completion, membership-renewal, and past-due emails send through SMTP with idempotent fallback. Daily cron scans 7-day Journey inactivity. Founder acceptance is not recorded.
implementation: Existing senders in auth email, billing notifications, support acknowledgment, journey progress, onboarding, Stripe sync-effects
